meaning: All three raw reviews retained; lower scores and disagreements not averaged. Gate from predeclared D plan.

all_scores_below4.evidence: Large cream words at upper left accompany two white flowers amid dark leaves, a literal and functioning expression of the title. The composition depends on the familiar low-key botanical photograph and poetic headline relationship more than a distinct editorial idea.

Title, recruitment, action, event details and body all use bold forms. The body paragraphs are readable and logically broken, but similar weight and tight line spacing make bringing an item, exclusions, repair limits, fee, filming and contact read as one heavy wall.

The image/title share the upper section and all lower copy uses the same left margin. However, the very large top section forces the final conditions into close vertical spacing; the full red URL approaches the right margin and the last contact line is close to the bottom.

Black mass and red application line produce a forceful public announcement. The action is exact and visible, but the equally heavy lower conditions make the tone more emphatic than the illustration alone requires.

Most copy is dark and bold: the large product name, right-side slogan/specification and centered release/order/URL. Grouping is functional, but little weight distinction inside those secondary blocks explains their relative importance.

The tall cup left and shorter cup right balance the middle. The slogan/specification is packed into the right pocket above the shorter cup, while top brand is left-aligned and bottom information is centered; these different alignment systems work but do not form an especially fluid whole.

720: two cream-white open blossoms and buds appear against dark foliage, directly supporting the garden subject. The cream title sits separately in the upper-left dark area; its placement has less specific relation to opening than the image itself.

Native/720: there is no obvious malformed copy or material collision, but the rectangular upper-left cream calligraphic title plus a full-bleed dramatic floral photograph is a reusable floral-book-cover package. The word placement does not materially change with the two flower forms, leaving generic editorial habits visible.

720: the headline is much larger, but date, restrictions, costs, consent and inquiry all use similarly heavy body strokes. Paragraph gaps group them reasonably; finer weight/size distinction is underdeveloped.

720: the mirror occupies the upper-right beside the title and the following copy shares one left edge. Its screwdriver approaches the right edge much more closely than the left text margin, and the lower body leaves a broad uneven right-side void. The overall structure functions but the small spatial relationships are less resolved.

720: the repair illustration and one red application accent give a practical friendly invitation. The dense uniformly bold lower policies flatten the tone and make almost every line feel equally insistent.

Native syllables and the URL are intact, and the large two-line heading is solid. Most subordinate copy is similarly bold, so the date, restrictions, fee and consent lines gain distinction mainly from blank rows rather than a refined weight hierarchy.

The square uses a packed heading/illustration zone and a largely left-aligned lower text stack. The longest restriction line extends farther right while shorter final rows leave a broad lower-right gap; functional balance is present but not especially resolved.
Black emphatic type and one red action strip create an urgent notice tone. The dense bold body makes the invitation feel more administrative than warm; the drawing supplies the main human-scale cue.

Native wood grain, skin and metal highlights are convincing locally, but the shaft ends around the hinge barrel/right-edge junction instead of clearly at one of the four obvious plate screw-head centers. That local contact ambiguity weakens the photograph’s repair finish.

The photograph’s tool contact at the hinge center-right remains a concrete unresolved construction cue: it is hard to read what the shaft engages. Otherwise the wood, skin, metal and glyph systems are coherent. The cue prevents an unqualified high-end/clean finish claim; it does not determine authorship.

all_set_records.evidence: Five visible directions differ in structure and type role: X110 stages bud-to-bloom vertically; X992 links a thin-letter terminal to a drawn stem; X232 uses a photographic flower with an upper-left headline; X412 makes the phrase follow a garden path; X143 uses huge block letters as a vine support. Closest pair X232/X412 shares dark green botanical surroundings, white flowers and soft cream Hangul, but photograph/headline versus illustrated path gives real structural distinction.
residuals: All five retain a dark field with flowers and four use cream type, so palette and some poetic botanical habits recur.
The weakest content/form score is X232=3: its image/headline relation remains mostly literal. This is not averaged away by the stronger title-integrated pieces.
